The Acorn Tiny House

A 220-square-foot tiny house on wheels, parked in a meadow at the edge of Fernwick. It has a sleeping loft with a queen mattress, a pull-out sofa bed downstairs, a composting toilet, and a deck for stargazing.

Amenities
- Propane heater
- Two-burner stove
- Outdoor fire pit
- Wi-Fi

House rules
- No pets
- No smoking anywhere on the property
- Campfires only in the fire pit

Check-in: 4:00 PM
Check-out: 11:00 AM
Nightly rate: $75 + $25 cleaning fee
